# ToolNest full content index

This file is a machine-readable map of ToolNest's public editorial pages. URLs are canonical and use the production host. The linked pages contain the authoritative text, structured data, sources, and current review context.

## How to interpret pages

- `/tools/` pages are individual product profiles.
- `/category/` pages group products by job.
- `/compare/` pages answer a two-product decision.
- `/alternatives/` pages explain replacement options.
- `/best/` pages are curated shortlists.
- `/goals/` pages begin with an outcome or task.
- `/about.html` describes sourcing, evidence labels, authorship, corrections, and affiliate disclosure.

## Tool profiles

The complete tool profile inventory is maintained in the [XML sitemap](https://www.toolnestai.tech/sitemap.xml). Each profile includes a direct answer, strengths, limitations, fit guidance, alternatives, and official-source context where applicable.

## Comparisons, alternatives, guides

Use the [comparison index](https://www.toolnestai.tech/compare/index.html), [alternative index](https://www.toolnestai.tech/alternatives/index.html), [best-of index](https://www.toolnestai.tech/best/index.html), and [goal index](https://www.toolnestai.tech/goals/index.html) to discover all current pages without relying on search-engine snippets.

## Trust and freshness

ToolNest is researched from official vendor sources by ToolNest Editorial using AI-assisted research. The site does not claim hands-on testing unless a page explicitly says so. Pricing and product facts are dated snapshots, not guarantees; readers should verify current terms with the vendor.
